python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
xl = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')
print('Sheets:', xl.sheet_names)
for s in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name=s, header=None)
    print('---', s, '---')
    print(df.to_string())
"

python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
df.columns = ['category', 'item', 'amount']
exp = df.iloc[10:22].copy()
exp = exp.dropna(subset=['amount'])
exp['amount'] = pd.to_numeric(exp['amount'])
print('=== Total Expenses by Category ===')
print(exp.groupby('category')['amount'].sum().to_string())
print()
print('Grand Total Expenses: \$%.2f' % exp['amount'].sum())
print('Number of expense line items:', len(exp))
"
